video_policy.principle: Small original IP videos and short documentary previews are stored in this GitHub repository; full-length documentary masters may be hosted externally when appropriate.
video_policy.github: Store all three small 9:16 original IP videos and lightweight documentary preview clips directly in the repository. Do not store large full-length masters.

video_policy.loading: preload=none; no autoplay; lazy-load posters and images.

source_policy.license_check: Verify the individual asset page and current license before download/use; retain source page, creator, license, access date, local filename, and any third-party rights notes.
source_policy.display_rule: Temporary stock media must not be presented as NORVA original work, documentary evidence, or a completed client project.
source_policy.delivery: Prefer local optimized WebP images over remote hotlinks; use public video embeds or external watch pages where embedding is explicitly available.
